zotero.readOnly: Search and preview only read your local Zotero library. Confirmation saves to the workspace without changing Zotero items.
zotero.setup: Open Zotero and allow local application access. Enable ZOTERO_MCP_ENABLED in the backend .env file, then restart the services.
zotero.queryPlaceholder: Enter a paper title, author, year, or keyword…
zotero.modeEverything: All fields and indexed full text
zotero.includeFulltext: Include indexed full text in the preview when available
zotero.searchHint: Separate words with spaces; Zotero treats a hyphen as OR. Full-text search requires indexed attachments in Zotero.
zotero.reading: Reading metadata and the requested full text…
zotero.resultCount: This search returned {count} items. Choose one to preview.
zotero.empty: No matching items found. Try different terms, tags, or search scope.
zotero.limitHint: Matches are grouped by work, so the item count may be below the limit. Raise the limit or refine the query to find more.
zotero.importIntro: Extract material from arXiv, DOI, GitHub, a local PDF, Zotero, or a configured MCP service. Nothing is saved to the library until you confirm.

import.existingPolicy: Open an existing import or save a separate note; sources in the recycle bin can be imported again.
import.trashedSource: The previous import is in the recycle bin. You can import again; the previous material stays in the recycle bin.
import.activeSource: This source is already imported. Open the existing material, or select Save as a separate note to save this draft.
import.saveAsNote: Save as a separate note (keep the source and existing material)
import.analysisHint: Send the current title, abstract and text to the configured model for a summary, methods, findings and limitations in the document’s main language. Image files are not sent. Review the result alongside the original before saving.
import.analysisReady: The analysis is at the start of the text, followed by the original and its images. Review and edit before saving. Changing interface language does not change the analysis.
import.restoreOriginal: Remove analysis and restore the earlier draft
import.excerptWarning: This text is long. Analysis uses excerpts from the beginning, middle and end, rather than the full text. The complete original is still retained.
